title: Countdown Day 40
excerpt: Not a bad quote to prepare for the new year with! So we set out on our quest, our exodus, driven out of familiar territory and into unmapped terra nova by ten questions stirring in our hearts. (22) From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith…
body:
Not a bad quote to prepare for the new year with!

 So we set out on our quest, our exodus, driven out of familiar territory and into unmapped terra nova by ten questions stirring in our hearts. (22)

 From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
